scope: Query-only thermal plus named-counter/RX/retune qualification; no thermal-control writes, TX, MMIO read-clear, ambient identifiers or raw frame captures.

commands.sequence: Initial runs requested 8 seconds; fixed-parser followups requested 15 seconds. Python and C ran separately on each device, with fresh firmware bring-up.

qualification.final_mixed_runs: passed both chips and implementations for short 2.4GHz channel1/11 retunes
qualification.initial_failure: Native MT7925 failed a counter sample after six thermal queries, with a matched reply and register alive. Exact reply not captured.
qualification.parser_regression: Deterministic Python/C regression reproduced: complete value8 rescanned as TLV could manufacture offset0. Parsers now skip complete entries; research readers reuse installed parser. Plausible, not proven attribution of the initial live failure.
qualification.temperature: Reported signed Celsius, not calibrated against an external reference or established same physical sensor across chips
qualification.adc: MT7925 raw codes only; no conversion
